input.answer: From what I read, it sounds worth having, because the employer puts in money on top of my salary. I can take it out without tax after 6 years, or after 3 years if it's for studies. Before I sign anything, I'll ask you or the bank about the 2% fee and which "מסלול" to pick.

stuck.why: Too many coloured bars and numbers. The red '−13,974 ₪' with the pink stripes scared me, and I couldn't tell if it was a loss or just tax. The brown and yellow colours were too close to tell apart.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the buttons under 'במה אפשר להשקיע בתוכו'
stuck.why: 'S&P 500 מדד' and 'מסלול כללי' mean nothing to me. I didn't know which one was the safe one.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row '123 מקור 123 מחושב 123 הזנתה'
stuck.why: I didn't understand what the coloured numbers were for, so I left them.

used: Title and subtitle: 'חיסכון שהמעסיק ואתם מפקידים אליו מהשכר... אחרי תקופה שקבע החוק אפשר למשוך בפטור ממס'
'אחרי 6 שנים מההפקדה הראשונה אפשר למשוך... ללא מס' and '3 שנים' for studies
'אפשר למשוך גם לפני 6 השנים, אבל אז משלמים' list
'למה משתמשים בזה': for employees it's usually the first step, since the employer's deposit only comes this way
Chart labels 'הפקדתם 18,000 ₪' and 'המעסיק הוסיף +54,000 ₪'
Card 'מתי הכסף פנוי: כשעוברות 6 שנים' and 'עד 4 ימי עסקים'
Fees table: 'דמי ניהול מחיסכון עד 2% בשנה', 'דמי יציאה אין'
skimmed: Screen 2 paragraph on depositing above the limit (25% tax on the real profit)
Screen 4 small grey notes on assumptions (7%, 2%, 47%)
'שווה לדעת' list with codes TXH-09, KH-15, PF-18
'מי מציע ומי מפקח' cards with company names
skipped: Small bar chart with the slider 'גרדו את הסמן'
Screens 7–9 (סיכונים ומה לא מוגן, מונחים): I was tired
not_found: A plain sentence on whether the money itself is safe like a deposit (maybe it's in 'סיכונים', which I didn't reach)
Which track is the safe one to choose
What fee is normal, not just 'עד 2%'

findings.what: A dark black background with grey letters, hard on my eyes even with glasses. The small grey lines were very tiring.
findings.where: Whole page, especially the notes on screen 4

findings.what: A red minus number with pink stripes in the middle of a chart scared me off without saying clearly in words what it is.
Busy chart with close colours (brown/yellow/green) and a slider
English letters and words I don't know right on the second screen
The fee says only 'עד 2%', so I can't tell if that's a lot or what I'd actually pay
Many little green tags and codes that look like links, cluttering the text
I don't know the site name 'מקור'. It doesn't say who's behind it, so I'm not sure I can trust it.
